justification: Inspected `src/main/java/org/jsoup/safety/Cleaner.java` (220 LOC) and `src/test/java/org/jsoup/safety/CleanerTest.java`. `Cleaner` is narrowly focused on one responsibility: cleaning/validating HTML against a `Safelist`. It has one field, one constructor, and only 3 public operations (`clean`, `isValid`, `isValidBodyHtml`), with the rest being a single inner visitor plus two private helpers that support the same sanitization workflow. The tests exercise only these related behaviors, and policy details are delegated to `Safelist`, so the class looks cohesive rather than insufficiently modularized.
